styleDescriptions.american_comic: bold American comic book art: strong black ink outlines, halftone dot shading, flat bright poster colours, dynamic cel highlights,  heroic drama in every contour
styleDescriptions.anime_cel: 1990s anime cel animation: clean outlines, two-tone cel shadows, saturated animator colours, crisp studio finish
styleDescriptions.art_deco_poster: Art Deco travel poster: streamlined symmetrical geometry, gold and teal palette, elegant flat shading, decorative sunburst accents
styleDescriptions.byzantine_mosaic: Byzantine mosaic art: small irregular gold and stone tesserae, curved piece-by-piece shading, glinting golden highlights
styleDescriptions.constructivist_poster: Soviet constructivist propaganda poster: stark red-black-cream reduction, bold diagonal shapes, flat printed ink surfaces
styleDescriptions.egyptian_tomb: ancient Egyptian tomb painting: limestone ground, flat profile figures, ochre and lapis palette, fine hieroglyph-like incisions
styleDescriptions.greek_pottery: ancient Greek black-figure pottery: terracotta clay ground, jet-black silhouettes with fine incised detail, meander key border accents
styleDescriptions.illuminated_manuscript: medieval illuminated manuscript: gold leaf accents, fine gothic ink linework, flat symbolic colour, ornate decorative flourishes
styleDescriptions.ligne_claire: Franco-Belgian ligne claire comics: uniform weight ink lines, flat saturation without hatching, clear readable shading
styleDescriptions.linocut_print: linocut relief print: chunky white carving lines through flat ink, bold two-tone contrast, hand-pressed texture
styleDescriptions.manga: Japanese manga art: crisp black-and-white ink work, screentone shading, clean economical linework, expressive emphasis strokes
styleDescriptions.naive_folk_art: naive folk art: charming simplification, rounded confident shapes, cheerful local palette, hand-painted brush texture
styleDescriptions.norse_woodcarving: carved Norse wood relief: deep knife-cut V-groove lines, knotted Nordic interlace tracery, warm oak grain surface
styleDescriptions.original_game_icons: 2D flat vector strategy game asset style, clean graphic game icon art direction. Uniform bold black outlines on elements combined with crisp lineless vector shapes. Flat solid color blocks, hard-edged geometric cel-shading, absolute absence of gradients or textures. Matte finish with simple pill-shaped white specular highlights on polished surfaces. High-contrast bold silhouettes, centered framing, isolated on a uniform flat solid pure black background
styleDescriptions.painted_miniature: hand-painted tabletop miniature: glossy enamel highlight layering with micro-brush precision, dramatic contrast lighting, display figure finish
styleDescriptions.papercraft: layered papercraft: cut-paper shapes with visible paper edges and fold seams, stacked depth layers, soft cast paper shadows
styleDescriptions.pixel_art: 16-bit strategy-game pixel art: chunky readable pixels, a limited clear palette, hard pixel edges, broad color clusters, and simple two- or three-tone shading; no dithering, gradients, or texture noise
styleDescriptions.stained_glass: stained glass window art: black lead came contour lines, glowing jewel-toned glass panes, light streaming through translucent colour
styleDescriptions.tarot_engraving: tarot card engraving: fine cross-hatched copper-plate lines, ornate symbolic composition, aged ivory paper
styleDescriptions.vintage_box_art: vintage 1970s board-game box art: rich gouache painting, warm retro palette, heroic painterly impression, printed cardstock feel
styleDescriptions.watercolor_storybook: ink-and-watercolour storybook art: loose wet washes, soft bleeding colours, fine pen-and-ink contour accents, warm paper tint

isometric 2D video game {presentation} of {subject}, isolated standalone central sprite, isometric strategic 3/4 game view showing height and volume, centrally composed asset, well-balanced framing, the whole subject complete and fully visible in the central canvas area, every part of the silhouette fully inside the frame and surrounded by generous clear margin on all four sides, tightly framed around the subject, centered on a completely uniform pure black background that fills the whole canvas edge to edge, easy masking background, game UI icon sprite, isolated subject.

Style & Art Direction: {art_direction}{style}

Theme accents only: {theme}. Keep the subject's natural colors and identity; no theme-driven replacement, glow, or dramatic lighting.

Subject Details: {details} The sprite shows ONLY the feature itself - {subject} - floating on a completely empty solid pure black #000000 background, clean flat black around every edge of the subject for easy masking.

Technical Specs: High contrast, top-down 45-degree isometric camera view, perfectly isolated subject on a pure black #000000 background, the full silhouette inside the frame with crisp black margin on all four sides, clean readable game sprite.

unit.artDirection: A coherent set of serious drawn strategy-game unit illustrations, like mature anime concept art crossed with a refined graphic novel: expressive but realistic proportions, confident dark ink contours, controlled cel shadows, subtle painterly material texture and restrained cinematic highlights. Keep the same line weight, shading, detail density and grounded palette across every unit, with a clear readable silhouette at small game-icon size. Clearly hand-drawn; no glossy 3D, chibi proportions or comic exaggeration.
